name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Black Cherry Punch
description:
Black Cherry Punch (Hybrid) - Flavor = tart Cherry + sweet fruits + woody pine. Long-lasting functioning high. Premium Distillate + Live Resin Terpenes

1-gram rechargeable disposable vapes are perfect for those that are on-the-go and that prioritize convenience. Each flavor is created with Premium distillate + Live Resin terpenes. We hold ourselves to a high standard of quality and a high standard of potency. Mitten + PLUS Disposables empower customers to reach new highs.
